plan_text:
第四个七小时窗口：重复标签与图形特征
窗口：2026-11-19 04:48:26–11:48:26 UTC；芝加哥11月18日22:48:26至19日05:48:26。

核心问题
相同的既有植物相关标签，在不同物理叶上是否具有较一致的可观察图形特征？本轮不预设植物物种、词义、读音或标签一定命名整个图形。

固定范围
okol：f101v.10、f88r.15。
otaly：f88r.6、f99v.6。
otoky：f88r.5、f99v.9。
otoldy：f89r1.4、f99r.14、f99v.2。
全部九位置、四物理叶保留；f99r/f99v为同叶。完整36对保留，其中27跨叶（5同标签、22异标签）；只有3个跨叶层同时有同/异标签，共19对，其余8对仍报告。72种既有重排只作设计盘点，不称可交换零分布。

阶段1：输入、旧分歧与测量资格
读取两轮既有引导定位及comparison_gate_v1，不抹去邻物交叉、95b矩形交集纠正和行序依赖。先冻结逐位置的候选图形、上下文、来源坐标及不确定边界；原上下文框不当作单对象分割。
在看新相似度结果之前，由另一代理审查全九归属、可见边界、邻物交叉、文字遮盖、对象/部件粒度及特征可观察性方案。保留多候选，不能为了单一对象而切掉不利部件；全图与未改原像始终可回看。任何视觉分组未知都和“确实没有该部件”分开。
本plan只批准输入盘点、文献及方案设计。新的遮盖/分割副本、形态编码和评分必须有后续完整测量合同及根批准。不能先算形态相似再决定文字对应哪个图形。

阶段2：有条件的图形特征比较
只有全固定范围达到明确测量资格并另冻合同后执行。特征、未知/不可比处理、形态描述粒度、评分者、全部对象对、叶对层与主量均在首次评分前固定。同一物理叶或共享对象不能当独立重复；同标签与异标签使用相同规则。若主量未能定义，报告具体缺口，不给伪零值。
可允许事先明确的多候选敏感性与保守范围；它不能用来掩盖尚未定义的单位。未经证实的72种可交换性不产生p值。另一实现核全部已有数值、分母、未知与贡献；数值一致不认证植物身份。

阶段3：直接先例与已知语言对照
并行查原始研究中标签、植物部件、绘图传统和图文归属的可检验主张，优先原文及馆藏材料。区分作者猜想、实际证据和本项目能检验的有限预测；不以二手报道确认破译或创新。
如九处主实验仍无资格，先完整交付缺口，再另冻已知语言植物图文对照资格调查或方法反例测试；不以换较容易的伏尼契子集替代九处总体。

发布与时间控制
原GitHub与Pages增加本轮计划、原图对照、测量资格、结果/失败、可复算入口及具体限制。保留旧页面与冻结版本，私有缓存路径不发布。
11:03:26 UTC之后不启动新的长实验；11:18:26 UTC开始最终发布与逐项验收。到11:48:26 UTC按实际进展收束，准确说明未完成项或停止分支。没有足够工作时不靠空等待、重复同AI审阅或GPU消耗填时间。

限制
已有标签、图像和判断都已曝光。匿名编号/遮盖只限制本次界面线索，不称新盲集或独立历史证据。不使用生成图像补字补图。图形相似不直接推出同一物种或词义，图形不同也不自动证明字串无意义。

joint_dependency_rules: Each group choice is a single node variable shared across all incident pairs. Do not select independently by same-label similarity.
f88_top_pale_spread is the same physical group in the f88r.5 alternative and f88r.6 working association. Shared-group scenarios are retained; a mandatory one-label-one-object rule is not established.
Fine interface strokes between f88_top_brown_pair and f88_top_pale_spread require one shared membership decision or unresolved state, not duplicate independent ownership.
No arbitrary union of two competitors is a candidate specimen. Each candidate retains its own components; graphic cores can be defined while particular ends or label associations remain uncertain.

approval_dependencies.identical_groups: f88_top_pale_spread is shared by f88r.6 and the corresponding f88r.5 alternative. Code it once; reuse the same canonical feature variable.
approval_dependencies.not_bijective: No demonstrated one-label-per-object convention; same-group scenarios retained.
approval_dependencies.fine_membership: Unresolved shared fine strokes cannot support two independent confident positive codes. Where ownership affects a feature, use unknown. Enumeration relaxes residual across-group and across-feature coupling; describe outer bounds, not sharp jointly realizable shapes.

records.name: local depicted widening
records.definition: Traceable wide outline relative to an attached connector, width ratio >=3; no flat/solid judgement or not-F1 exclusion. Do not use terminal taper, corner or globally thinnest pixel as neck.
records.necessary_record: Width and connector cross-sections, local direction, boundary alternatives, drawing style, threshold uncertainty.
records.limitation: Ink-line width is a depiction feature, not biological diameter. Definability is not guaranteed.

records.name: traceable three-arm connection
records.definition: At least three separately traceable connector arms reach one visible joining region; undirected and independent of plant orientation.
records.necessary_record: Joining-region and arm witnesses; distinguish connector arms from two edges of one outline.
records.limitation: Crossing, overlap or concealed contact remains unknown when connectivity cannot be established.

records.name: at least three slender ends
records.definition: At least three distinct ends with traceable length from last attachment/fork to end, divided by maximum transverse width of the same extension, >=3.
records.necessary_record: End witnesses, lengths/widths, count lower/upper bounds; single-ink-line drawing explicitly recorded.
records.limitation: Unknown ownership or branching cannot manufacture distinct ends; paper geometry does not identify roots/leaves.

records.name: repeated internal transverse lines
records.definition: At least two distinct lines inside one traceable shaft each connect its two sides and occur sequentially along it.
records.necessary_record: Shaft extent, two boundary-spanning line witnesses, excluded text/other-object/crack alternatives.
records.limitation: No claim of biological compartments. Geometrically qualifying hatching cannot be removed solely by inferred function.

ambiguity_record.scope: Conservative handling of an unresolved operational-definition ambiguity; does not alter G1 threshold or assert absence.
ambiguity_record.trigger: Coder asked whether a narrow extension connected to a widened region but freely terminating at its other end satisfies the frozen requirement that the connector lead to another traceable graphical structure.
ambiguity_record.decision: Do not resolve this ambiguity in favor of a measured positive or negative during coding. If no other unambiguously qualifying widening witness exists, retain G1=null with reason definition_applicability_ambiguous_free_terminal_connector. Apply to all such candidate groups. Preserve any width evidence separately; do not infer a hidden second attachment.
ambiguity_record.effect: Allowed binary domain remains {0,1}; this widens descriptive outer bounds. No imputation to zero, new feature family, changed ratio threshold, or candidate reassignment.
ambiguity_record.future: A clarified operational definition can be tested prospectively in a later separate version, not retrofitted to current label-comparison results.

coding_rules.positive: One unambiguous belonging instance suffices within a fixed candidate; other missing portions need not invalidate it.
coding_rules.negative: All possible qualifying instances ruled out across relevant complete candidate scope.
coding_rules.unknown: Ambiguous visibility, assignment, extent or threshold; never filled with zero.
coding_rules.threshold_intervals: For width threshold: w_lower >= 3*n_upper certifies passing; w_upper < 3*n_lower certifies failing for that instance; overlap retains uncertainty.
